method: Three process runs per variant, with baseline/candidate order randomized before execution within each pair. Each immutable copied release executable runs the stationary and pointer-driven drag/release/idle tests sequentially, with twenty warm samples per size. No concurrent Cargo validation during sampling. CPU widget processing and tessellation only: no GPU or application frame measurement. Distributions are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Candidate includes both current-fast-rendering and initial-canvas-only allocation planning guards. Final summaries refer only to candidate-v4 trials; earlier v3 reports remain separate. Whole-frame identity equality guards cover deleted targets left registered during the same pass.

candidate-v4.description: Plan only after initial node-target allocation and outside fast rendering. Full raising on any change to overall node/header/toggle/socket target identities or minimap visibility; per-node geometry and isolation guards unchanged.
